C0205.title: CAC Shuts Down Over 400 Fake Traffic Websites and Platforms
C0205.summary: Since 2024, the Cyberspace Administration of China has continued cracking down on organized online water armies engaging in fake reviews, inflated follower counts, and manipulated rankings. It coordinated the shutdown of over 400 websites and platforms, urged the cleanup of 4.82 million pieces of illegal information, and handled 2.39 million accounts and merchant stores.
